title: Nested-OOF class-safe selective correction screen
hypothesis: A conservative correction policy learned only from fold-training OOF predictions can improve a strong frozen DINOv2 RBF classifier without harming any class.
features: Frozen official DINOv2 ViT-B/14 CLS, L2 normalized

reference.method: sklearn RBF SVC C=3 gamma=scale using SVC.predict

leakage_control.outer_evaluation: Each original fold is predicted by models and a correction policy fitted without any image or label from that fold.
leakage_control.inner_oof: Within each outer training split, each of the four remaining original folds is predicted from the other three folds.
leakage_control.policy_fit: Thresholds and ordered confusion-pair reliability are learned only from inner-OOF predictions and labels.

candidate_evidence.rbf_confidence: top-1 minus top-2 SVC decision-function margin
candidate_evidence.prototype: nearest L2-normalized class mean by cosine similarity
candidate_evidence.knn: cosine k-nearest-neighbor majority with similarity-sum tie breaking
candidate_evidence.eligible_action: prototype and kNN agree on the same class and disagree with RBF

policy_search_inside_each_outer_fold.ordered_pair_acceptance: at least 2 inner-OOF wins and exactly 0 inner-OOF harms
policy_search_inside_each_outer_fold.tie_breaking: higher net gain, then more wins, fewer actions, lower margin quantile, higher purity, smaller k
policy_search_inside_each_outer_fold.fallback: retain all RBF predictions when no configuration qualifies

selection_rule.confirmation: Only if all gates pass, freeze the complete policy and generate untouched train-only episodes 4 and 5. Official test remains locked.

reporting: changed predictions split into wins, harms, and neutral changes
per-outer-fold selected configuration and action count
